extracted.name: Boiling Water Pastry
extracted.description: There’s no surprise in this simple, no-fail how water pastry recipe. There’s pastry flour and boiling water in this wonderfully flaky pie crust. It’s perfect for your favorite pie filling.
instruction_lines: Place shortening into a heat-proof bowl. Pour in boiling water and whip mixture until creamy.
Mix together flour and salt in a separate bowl. Add flour mixture to shortening mixture. Stir until pastry stops sticking to the sides of the bowl. Refrigerate pastry before rolling it out.
